goal: Make board support a retrieval-friendly, source-backed Agent Skill without regressing the Arduino skill package.

primary_metric.name: board_support_retrieval_contract_gates
primary_metric.threshold: at least six new board-support gates pass while all existing gates remain green

correctness_gates: protected board profile hashes and constexpr pin fixture remain unchanged
independent acceptance and quality/regression reviews return no critical defect
hard_constraints: Preserve raw ordered constexpr int declarations with no extra syntax or explanation in declarations-only output.
Preserve C/C++ embedded-first guidance; use Python only for relevant deterministic tooling.
Use exact board, revision, module suffix, framework, core, and toolchain identity before board-specific advice.
Keep build, upload, hardware, system, and deployment evidence separate.
Never claim physical success without a user-provided measurement, log, or photo.
Do not weaken an evaluator to make a candidate pass.
Do not duplicate skill bodies in provider adapters or add unrelated skill scope.

commands: sha256sum evals/fixtures/esp32-buttons-leds.txt references/boards/arduino-uno-r3.md references/boards/arduino-uno-r4.md references/boards/esp32-devkit.md references/boards/esp32-s3-devkit.md references/boards/pico-pico-w.md
results: worktree clean on main; protected hashes recorded

best_known_state.source: deterministic repository and official plugin gates

per_iteration_budget: one bounded research or implementation change followed by targeted validation
evaluation_method: existing repository validators plus resolver-backed retrieval scenarios, held-out trigger corpus shape checks, and independent review
acceptance_rule: Keep the candidate only if the retrieval metric reaches at least six, all correctness gates pass, and protected hashes remain unchanged.
rollback_method: Restore only the files listed in editable_surface after inspecting the diff; preserve unrelated user changes and rerun the baseline gates.
plateau_rule: Stop after two consecutive candidate boundaries fail to add a measurable retrieval gate or introduce unresolved trigger ambiguity.
stop_conditions: Research cannot distinguish a new skill from a board-selection upgrade without ambiguous trigger ownership.
A proposed field cannot be source-backed or safely marked unknown.
A repair would weaken the evaluator or hide an evidence stage.
Physical validation is requested but unavailable.
